'''Ravendeviant''' is an artist whose image is used on two [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of Ravendeviant" and "Image courtesy of Ravendeviant on DeviantArt". The credit points to DeviantArt, an online art community. The credited cards are [[Blue 11|•Blue 11]] and [[Grogu In Razor Crest|•Grogu In Razor Crest]], in [[Virtual Set 9]] and [[Virtual Set 27]] (released 2018–2026).
